summary: This document specifies the Deterministic Networking (DetNet) data plane for carrying IP packets over an MPLS packet-switched network. It describes how DetNet IP flows are encapsulated so they can ride across MPLS while keeping DetNet's service properties.

eli5.summary: Some messages need a reliable express delivery. This document explains how to put such delivery-promised internet messages inside another kind of network wrapper called MPLS and still keep the promise.

questions: how are detnet ip flows carried over mpls
